title: TermSheet
description: Multi-issue term sheet carried in every binding Offer (NEG section 5.3; TRD section 17.2; TRADE-104, TRADE-107). Every issue carries {value, negotiable, status}. Reservation values never appear here (NEG-140). Issues not listed are fixed (NEG section 5.2).

pricing_basis.description: NEG-171. Device/OS-based pricing is prohibited regardless of basis.

parties.description: TRADE-101: orderer, consignee and payer may differ.

mrp.description: From catalog price.maximum_value. Read-only, never negotiable (NEG section 5.11).

retail_package_mrp_required.description: True only for a retail package that must bear MRP. LM(PC) Rules r.18(2) ceiling applies. Rule 3 exemptions (industrial/institutional consumer packs, over 25 kg) are false (to be verified; NEG-170).

asserted_by_buyer.description: False for seller-added lines. A counter may not add unasserted lines (anti basket-sneaking, NEG section 5.12).

first_disclosed_round.description: Round in which the fee first appeared. A fee first disclosed after round 1 forces re-consent (TRADE-121).

all_in_total.description: Every mandatory charge incl. tax. REQUIRED from round 1 (NEG-122). Must equal Beckn quote.price.

incoterm.description: FOR_DESTINATION is Indian domestic practice, not an Incoterm (TRD section 5).

items.description: One payment alternative with its own all-in total, so COD vs prepaid prices are visible from round 1 (PAY-132, NEG-122).

event.description: Beckn timing vocabulary (NEG section 1.1) plus acceptance events: GRN for MSMED, CRAC for GeM.

is_credit.description: True when goods/services move before this tranche is paid (trade credit).

deductible_from_final.description: Token/advance adjusted against the final amount.

emi.description: PAY-117, PAY-125. no_cost MUST be false when interest_amount > 0.

deducted_at_source.description: e.g. arhtiya commission or interlocked loan repayment shown as a separate line (TRADE-150).

linked_agreement_ref.description: e.g. registered RERA agreement for sale, required above 10% (TRADE-118).

conditions_precedent.description: ICA s.6: offer lapses if a condition precedent fails (section 12.5).

extensions.description: Namespaced extra issues. Guards fail closed on any extension issue not in Agree (NEG-132).

fx.description: REQ-405 / TRADE-144 (L7-compliance C-5): foreign-currency view of a cross-border payment. Settlement stays INR: inr_total is an INR Amount = round(foreign_amount * rate * (1 + markup_bps/10000)).

conditional.description: Conditional/deferred cashback MUST NOT be counted in all_in_total (PAYC section 7).

allOf.description: MSMED s.15 cap: a manufacturing or services micro/small seller may not be given more than 45 days from acceptance or deemed acceptance (NEG-162, TRADE-108). Traders are excluded pending verification.
An interest-bearing EMI cannot be described as no-cost (PAY-117).
